class.name: drag_teleop_controller/DragTeleopController
class.description: Master/slave drag teleoperation controller. Runs as either the master (dragged by the operator, gravity compensated) or the slave (follows the master) role. Supports position / mit / effort control modes and position / effort force feedback on the master side. Teleop states are joint-mapped before publishing; grippers are handled by adaptive_gripper_controller (spawned by the launch file).
